# ScrollTrace

> ScrollTrace is a free Android app (Android 8.0+) that counts how many Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and TikTok videos a person swipes through each day, and estimates the time spent. It measures short-form scrolling; it does not block apps. Made by Badal Lalwani, an independent developer in Jabalpur, India. Install: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.baadalalwani.scrolltrace

Key facts:
- Category: digital wellbeing / doomscroll tracker (tracker, not blocker, not pause app)
- Tracks: Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, TikTok and TikTok Lite. Does not count regular feed, Stories, long videos or messages.
- Method: Android Accessibility service restricted to those apps detects each swipe to a new video. Time = count x typical length (Reel ~22s, Short ~35s, TikTok ~20s).
- Price: free; optional Pro subscription via Google Play.
- Not available on iPhone.
- Scroll history is stored on the device; limited usage analytics go to Google Firebase. See privacy page.

- [Privacy and permissions](https://scrolltrace.in/privacy/): what the app can see, stores and sends
- [Compare](https://scrolltrace.in/compare/): ScrollTrace vs Shortstop, one sec, ScreenZen and Digital Wellbeing
